words.scene: 系统安全：通过设计绕过限制
words.example: The team found a way to circumvent the security restriction without compromising safety.
words.translation: 团队找到了一种在不影响安全的情况下规避安全限制的方法。

words.scene: 团队协作：识别阻碍进展的因素
words.example: A lack of clear communication can hinder progress on the project.
words.translation: 缺乏清晰的沟通可能会阻碍项目的进展。

words.scene: 安全监控：检测即将发生的威胁
words.example: The system alerts operators when an imminent threat is detected.
words.translation: 当检测到即将发生的威胁时，系统会提醒操作员。

words.scene: 软件开发：先搭建项目骨架再逐步填充功能
words.example: The team decided to scaffold a prototype before writing the full implementation.
words.translation: 团队决定在编写完整实现之前先搭建一个原型骨架。

words.scene: 论文写作：检查段落之间的逻辑连贯性
words.example: Good transitions help maintain cohesion across the sections of a paper.
words.translation: 恰当的过渡有助于保持论文各章节之间的连贯性。

words.scene: AI 安全：对模型输出保持持续警惕
words.example: Operators must exercise vigilance when reviewing outputs from an AI system.
words.translation: 操作人员在审查人工智能系统的输出时必须保持警惕。

words.scene: 机器人：传感器与障碍物距离过近时触发避让
words.example: The robot slows down when it detects an obstacle in close proximity.
words.translation: 当机器人检测到附近有障碍物时会减速。

words.scene: 工程管理：团队固定的迭代发布节奏
words.example: A steady release cadence keeps users informed about new changes.
words.translation: 稳定的发布节奏能让用户及时了解新的变化。

words.scene: 文献阅读：在海量论文中辨别真正有价值的工作
words.example: Reading widely helps students develop discernment about which papers matter.
words.translation: 广泛阅读有助于学生培养辨别哪些论文真正重要的洞察力。

words.scene: 论文写作：确保论证结构前后一致
words.example: The reviewer praised the logical coherence of the argument.
words.translation: 审稿人称赞了该论证的逻辑连贯性。
